site: ADP final application step; shared approval comparison
class: Final-step evidence was assumed to remain visible under the original posting route
symptom: A completed final application was ready to submit but verified auto-submit refused its post-login URL, hidden resume attachment and approved electronic-signing checkbox.
root_cause: Identity comparison treated the posting and post-login routes as different applications; attachment inspection considered only the current panel; approval resolution could not associate a checked signing declaration with the owner's explicit signing preference. The signature detector also missed sign electronically wording.
why_tests_missed: Existing auto-submit tests kept the same URL, attachment and ordinary profile fields on a single final page. They did not model ADP's internal requisition metadata, separate review panel or a rebuilt declaration control.
fix: Verify ADP tenant and requisition metadata before normalizing identity; read the actual review panel and restore the final panel before comparisons; resolve checked declarations only from their explicit profile permissions. Preserve local document hashing and every existing submission gate.
prevention: Exercise multi-panel portals and authenticated route transitions in submission tests. Require independent job identity, fresh attachment evidence and explicit declaration permission rather than weakening the gate to make a form eligible.
